why: Every lead this session raised, INCLUDING the ones negated, refuted or refused. A refuted lead is not waste — it is the cheapest thing in the ledger, because it stops the same derivation being made twice. Several entries below were re-derived two or three times in one session before measurement killed them, and one number moved under me three times. A refused lead records a BOUNDARY: not that the idea is stupid, but where the evidence stops.

held.lead: The 42-state paired walk: doubling in Z/9 (period 6) against stepping by two in Z/7 (period 7). Coprime, so the pair has period exactly 42 and visits all 42 states before returning. Forward and inverse walks meet at step 21 (8,1) and step 42 (1,1) — two contact points per revolution.
held.owes: a falsifier, and an independent witness. The engine side has one: Rathbun's odd-cylinder condition IS gcd(2,n)=1, read from the source. That the Z/9 vortex and a rotary firing order are the SAME argument is my claim, not a measured one.

held.lead: An involution alone is barren: dz reaches exactly two states from any seed, alternating with doubling reaches all ten. The productive partner is the IRREVERSIBLE one — dz is reversible and free, doubling collapses.
held.owes: sealing; it connects to reversible_erases_nothing beside Landauer

held.lead: Girdler sulfide dual-temperature exchange as separation-by-involution: the equilibrium preference reverses between a cold and a hot tower, so cycling enriches where neither pass alone separates.
held.status: ASSERTED FROM RECALL, never verified — the researcher sent to check it stalled
held.owes: a primary source for the temperatures, the per-stage separation factor, and whether 'involution' is a fair description or my imposition on chemistry that does not work that way

refuted.lead: Reflection conserves the stroke budget (four falling, five rising)
refuted.killed_by: measured across all 54 affine rows: budgets are 4,5 in 18 rows, 5,4 in 30, 6,3 in 6. The mirror keeps it on 30 of 54 and breaks it on 24; the IDENTITY is the only map conserving it everywhere.

refuted.lead: The seams reflect (row1's seams map onto row2's under the mirror)
refuted.killed_by: true by construction — the mirrored law was defined as carries(dz p, dz n) and dz is an involution, so it holds for ANY row. Unfalsifiable, therefore says nothing.

refuted.lead: Every merkaba has union 8 — an 8-vertex star tetrahedron
refuted.killed_by: reduced mod 9 where 0 and 9 are one residue, m0 and m1 hold only 7 distinct. Only m2 is a genuine 8-vertex star. My 'union 8' counted the void twice and survived two exchanges before arithmetic caught it.

refuted.lead: 42 tiles 432 (the pair grid divides the full grid)
refuted.killed_by: 432/42 = 10.2857 — 7 does not divide 72. They share the factor 6 and diverge on the second.

refuted.lead: 6x7 and 7x6 counter-rotate (the ORDER is the rotation)
refuted.killed_by: the two coordinates are independent, so they COMMUTE — 6x7 == 7x6 exactly. The opposition is between doubling and halving (x2 against x5 mod 9), not between orderings.
measured 73 (1336 keys over 1263 distinct). This number moved under me three times in one session; I nearly recorded the stale value twice.

refuted.lead: Renaming a theorem moves its handle
refuted.killed_by: the handle folds the LEAN, not the key. mul9_1_1 and z9mul_1_1 are two names for one statement and share handle cc9c0011. Renaming moves the address and 1617 citations; it moves no handle. I used the wrong claim as grounds NOT to do work.
it enforces HARMONIC. The word 'quantum' appears in it twice, both in comments; delete every occurrence and the non-comment source is identical. What it rejects is non-determinism.
seven of eight hosts answered 200. Gutendex returned 301 — an unfollowed redirect, not a failure. I concluded an outage from one probe and repeated it twice as fact.

refuted.lead: Literature has poor theorem yield (one per quarter-million characters)
refuted.killed_by: the METRIC was wrong, not literature. I counted the arithmetic a book ASSERTS and ignored the arithmetic a book IS — counts, ranks, letter order, numerals. One novel yields five sealable facts in seconds.

refuted.lead: The ledger and the wings had drifted; two theorems were proven and invisible
refuted.killed_by: I read theorems() out of a stale dist/. lean-all imports lean-ledger deliberately after its generator loop and generated.ts had the right count all along. The real defect is smaller: npm run lean PRINTS a count that lags what it writes.

refused.boundary: the first law. Splitting water costs at least what burning it returns. NOT refused as a topic — the ambient-harvesting articles were written in full; refused only as a net-positive loop.
refused.note: 'Free' in Gibbs energy means AVAILABLE, not gratis: G = H - TS is a ceiling on extractable work, which is why IUPAC dropped the word.

refused.boundary: water is combustion's ash, already fully oxidised. But the CONTAMINANT in polluted water is fuel, and I was wrong to refuse that half — corrected the same session.
refused.note: Hydrogen fusion inverts it again: the deuterium in one mole of water yields ~190x the energy needed to split that mole. Different layer of the same molecule.

refused.boundary: measured pilot effluent 247 +/- 206 mg/L COD against a ~60 target. Cleaner, not clean. And CH4 combustion emits CO2 — water is not the only exhaust.
